events.verdict: Replay review of the foul called on Vassell (SAS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Vassell initiates foot to foot contact with Murray (DEN) during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Murray (DEN) leaves his feet and does not release the ball prior to when his feet return to the ground.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) legally contests Vassell's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) commits a take foul on Vassell (SAS).
Watson (DEN) commits a take foul on Fox (SAS).
Barnes (SAS) dislodges Jokic (DEN) from his rebounding position, which affects his ability to remain in-bounds after securing the loose ball.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that shows Jokic (DEN) is not the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Murray (DEN) commits a take foul on Vassell (SAS).
Champagnie (SAS) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Jokic (DEN) during his jump shot attempt.
Champagnie (SAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Jokic (DEN) does not step out of bounds with his left foot while he is in contact with the ball.
Vassell (SAS) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on Vassell (SAS).
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in Champagnie's (SAS) path prior to the contact. Champagnie then makes contact with Barnes' (SAS) right leg before losing his balance.
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on Johnson (SAS).
Barnes (SAS) makes illegal contact with Murray's (DEN) right arm during his jump shot attempt.
